ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio. Approximately 80% high-intensity white central pixels bordered by 20% low-intensity black/dark-grey peripheral pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous region across the interior of both lobes. High-contrast dark peripheral banding along the trailing edge. Multiple discrete dark circular/ovoid focal spots (mottling) distributed across the white surface, concentrated more heavily on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels. Jagged peaks and deep valleys are consistent along the entire visible trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on the distal edges sweeping upward toward highly irregular, textured terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters ranging from 3 to 10 pixels in diameter scattered across the ventral white surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular textural massing and dark pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with heavy barnacle colonization/encrustation.
